newsitem.title: GERMANY: Direction of German DAX seen dependent on Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Direction of German DAX seen dependent on Telekom.

text.p: The direction of Germany's DAX index of 30 leading shares, now including newly-floated Deutsche Telekom, was expected to continue to be dependent on its new member this week.

The IBIS DAX, which measures all-day computer dealings in the DAX index, recovered some ground as Wall Street opened firmer, but dealers said the index could have been in record high territory, had it not been for Telekom losses.
Telekom shares ended bourse dealings down five percent, or 1.83 marks at 32.07 marks, and continued to slip in post-bourse dealings to stand down at 31.67 marks.
